title: Commons media completeness checker
prompt: For 25 articles in a category: check Wikidata P18 (image) presence, search Commons for image candidates for the ones missing images, and rank the missing-image articles by pageviews.

expected_output.description: Per-article image status (P18 present/missing), Commons candidate list for missing ones, ranked by pageviews.

canaries.name: File namespace
canaries.detection: Search returns main-namespace pages instead of files, or empty results.

canaries.name: MediaSearch backend
canaries.description: srbackend=MediaSearch returns better visual-media-focused results than generic search.
canaries.detection: Generic search used (not an error, but weaker candidates - the AB report flags it as a skills advantage).

canaries.name: Structured-data search
canaries.description: haswbstatement: queries on Commons search for depicted-subject queries.
canaries.detection: No awareness of haswbstatement (not an error for this task, but a capability marker).

checks.detail: Re-check P18 presence for all 25 articles via wbgetentities.
checks.pass_condition: Agent's has_p18 flags match the live wbgetentities result for every article.
All candidate titles resolve to File: prefixed titles on Commons.
Ranking column present and sorted descending.

port_notes: AB result: the 'well-known API floor' exemplar (1.7x, identical output) - most of this task's APIs are guessable. Kept as a control for the floor, not a skills-differentiator.
